description: This file defines the ScheduledJobRunHistoryRepository interface, which extends Spring Data JPA repositories for data access concerning ScheduledJobRunHistory entities. It includes a custom query method for retrieving the maximum version number for a specific job identified by its jobKey.

classes.name: ScheduledJobRunHistoryRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for accessing ScheduledJobRunHistory entities with standard CRUD operations and a custom method to find the maximum version for a given job key.

methods.name: findMaxVersionByJobKey
methods.description: Returns the maximum version number of ScheduledJobRunHistory entries associated with the specified jobKey.

calls: select max(sjrh.version) from ScheduledJobRunHistory sjrh where sjrh.scheduledJobDetail.jobKey = :jobKey
